prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit stretch of the Great Wall of China with worn brick paving, waist-high crenellated parapet, standard-height arched gate and stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, deep dark brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a copper round bell, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver rings. LEFT Body Art: full body polished white marble fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pale white marble surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID golden vein striations flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her body carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
